RRB Technician CEN 02/2025 DV Call Letter 2026

Post Date: June 17, 2026

10:37 am

Railway Recruitment Board RRB Railway, has released the DV Call Letter on the official website for the recruitment of Technician Gr-I & Grade-III (CEN.No.02/2025). The exam was conducted on 06, 09, 10 & 13 March 2026, and the last date to submit the application form was 07 August 2025. Candidates Can Also Check their Result using their Enrollment Number, Registration Number, or Date of Birth by logging into the portal. The direct links are provided below. (CEN.No 02/2025)
